planets.name: TOI-1135 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1135 with a 8.03-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1135 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1135. Its orbit and size follow Dugan et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DUGAN_ET_AL_2025): disc_year 2024, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 8.0277326, pl_radj 0.885, pl_bmassj 0.185
